title: Antipasto Skewer Board
seo_title: Antipasto Skewers Board for 10–16: Shopping List & Plan
description: An antipasto skewer board for 10–16: caprese, salami-provolone and Parmesan-soppressata skewers with olives, artichokes, roasted peppers and focaccia.
hook: Twenty ready-made antipasto bites standing on one board: no utensils, no guesswork, pure Italian style.
why: Every skewer is a complete four-part bite (meat, cheese, vegetable and herb), so the pairing is done for your guests. The board uses three: caprese with prosciutto, salami with provolone, olive and pepper, and Parmesan with soppressata and artichoke.
Standing the skewers up adds height a flat board can't, and the whole thing works without plates or knives. Extra olives, focaccia and a dish of herbed olive oil fill the rest.

timeline.what: Arrange the skewers on the board; set out the dips.
Add the loose olives, bread and garnish.

faq.a: Cherry tomato, mozzarella and basil with prosciutto; salami, provolone, olive and roasted pepper; Parmesan, soppressata and artichoke.

faq.q: Can I make antipasto skewers ahead?
faq.a: Yes. Build them up to 4 hours ahead and keep them covered in the fridge. Add basil leaves close to serving so they don't wilt.
About 2 to 3 per person as an appetizer.
